added_failures_note: unmeasured: the reviewed run is not an armed role and names no base/after gate logs, so the added-failure count was not taken; the reviewed manifest reads 'none: not an armed role' for baseline_suite and after_suite

findings.text: follow-on: both TestMapClaimPredicate tests assert only that the generated status predicate contains the no-binding clause (test_claims_selected_edge_without_binding, test_bound_source_is_skipped_by_the_no_binding_clause), so the done-when item 'a second magnetics pass skips it' rests on string content. The live graph test proves the complementary direction - a source bound only into magnetics is claimed by the summary pass - but never asserts that the magnetics pass returns nothing once magnetics is bound. A single live-graph assertion, claim_sources_for_mapping(facility, 'magnetics') == [] once the magnetics binding exists, would close it at the level the rule runs.

justifications.durability: the fix is proven at the level the defect lived: map_worker over two IDSs in one run (TestMapWorkerMapsEveryIdsOfOneSource), the validate stage routed through the single owner (TestValidateStageUsesTheSingleStatusOwner), and the status rule as live Cypher (test_mapping_status_rule_against_the_live_graph, -m graph, unique fixture removed in a finally). The production-dead Python copy of the rule (_mapping_status_for) and the set_mapping_status literal writer it shadowed are deleted, so the rule has one owner. The one gap is the follow-on below: 'a second magnetics pass skips it' is proven by predicate text, not a claim.
justifications.evidence: the reviewed run's broad gate is green (gate_repair.log: 2766 passed, 7 skipped, 3 deselected, exit 0) and I re-ran the focused new tests at head to 35 passed, 1 deselected, exit 0, plus the graph-marked live test to 1 passed, exit 0 (focused_head.log, focused_head_graph.log). The negative control is genuine: I reverted the handled key to source id alone in a scratch tree and TestMapWorkerMapsEveryIdsOfOneSource failed 2, exit 1 (negative_control_delta.log). One residual gap, recorded as a follow-on: TestMapClaimPredicate proves the second-pass skip by predicate text rather than a claim.
justifications.fit: one function (refresh_mapping_status, workers.py:344) now owns the assigned/mapped/validated rule and both the map and validate stages call it (workers.py:868, workers.py:1061), so no stage writes a status literal; the status logic stays beside the other claim predicates and the Cypher sits with the source's reads. No plan, sprint or ticket label appears in a new symbol.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the delta repairs the prior review's blocking finding: map_worker now keys its handled record by (IDS, source) (imas_codex/ids/workers.py:773, filtered at :790) and releases the claim of any claimed source a finished pass skips (:791-793), so a source whose selected edges span magnetics and summary is mapped by each IDS's pass. It also completes the per-IDS claim by folding the claim clear into the single status owner refresh_mapping_status (workers.py:344), so a finished pass releases the source for the other IDS's pass in the same run. Every done-when item of the map-run-maps-each-home node now holds at the head.
justifications.reuse: the change removes a duplicated rule rather than adding one: the dead _mapping_status_for and the set_mapping_status literal writer are deleted, and its two callers share the single owner. The only residual duplication is the predicate-text assertion in TestMapClaimPredicate, a test weakness rather than a second implementation.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --stat c4e3bf1b3146d8d89f395328d7e591b2c23d9ce8..7018c00526d5b0600ebc39a962df4486524bccf1 changes only the four declared paths: imas_codex/ids/workers.py, tests/ids/test_map_each_home.py, tests/ids/test_escalated_target_choice.py and docs/evidence/fragments/mapping-candidate-selection/map-run-maps-each-home.html. No generated model is staged. The retired-field census is clean at the head: git grep -nE 'mapping_target_ids|mapping_target_path|mapping_target_type|claim_sources_for_assignment' at 7018c0052 prints nothing (exit 1), and set_mapping_status appears only in the new test's own negative hasattr assertion.
